title: The Formery

services.name: Teacher Training
services.desc: The Function Pilates Teacher Training Program is designed to prepare students for the growing Pilates industry through a combination of anatomy, exercise programming, posture assessment, teaching methodology, and real-world experience. Students learn how to customize workouts based on client goals, injuries, limitations, and posture while developing the skills needed to teach both private sessions and group classes. Includes Mat, Reformer, Cadillac, Wunda Chair, Ladder Barrel and Spine Corrector We recommend at least 15 hours of Pilates experience with a certified instructor, but it is not required.
